source.title: Gamma roadmap: intelligent starter actions, multimodal documents, safe Excel, tool-first architecture
source.body:
# Gamma architecture roadmap — tool-first, not reinventing the wheel

**Status:** Planned only. **Gate:** Complete controlled human Beta and document-retrieval validation before implementing Gamma. This issue is a durable planning record; it authorizes no changes to main, production, billing, or user data.

## Product principles
- Gemini remains the reasoning/orchestration brain. Understand intent in DE/FA/EN (extensible to more languages); use tools only when useful.
- Evidence priority: verified internal living archive and standards -> general reasoning -> public web where appropriate; preserve deterministic safety/standards verification, precise citations for verified claims, uncertainty on insufficient evidence.
- **Use -> Extend -> Build**: evaluate native ChatGPT/OpenAI capabilities, GitHub integrations/actions, established libraries and APIs before building bespoke implementations. Avoid duplicating PDF reading/summarization, OCR, Excel execution, document parsing, search, and file management.
- Review newly available tools and connector capabilities at implementation time against cost, security, privacy, vendor lock-in, quality, and maintenance. Do not assume a capability exists or is free until verified.
- Keep elevator.help technical assistance separate from the later commercial **Elevator Agent AI** supplier/parts marketplace. Provide a future handoff interface, not premature marketplace implementation.

## Six starter actions and expected behaviors
1. **Troubleshoot a fault**: ask manufacturer/model/fault code/context; optionally analyze photo/document; provide evidence-based, safety-conscious diagnostics.
2. **Search technical documentation**: retrieve relevant verified internal documentation first; provide grounded answer and citation where permitted; fallback appropriately.
3. **Ask about EN 81-20 / EN 81-50**: retrieve authoritative text, verify clause/numbers deterministically, fail closed on unverified normative claims.
4. **Plan shaft dimensions**: gather capacity, lift type, building constraints; provide clearly labeled preliminary guidance, not certified design.
5. **Send a photo**: inspect image, identify visible objects/labels and uncertainty; ask *what the user wants to do* (identify component, troubleshoot, find manual, find spare part, find supplier). Never infer unseen technical properties.
6. **Upload a document**: securely parse PDF/images/office files as supported, extract text/tables, summarize, answer user questions grounded in the uploaded file; ask intent when ambiguous.

## Proposed phased Gamma work
- **Gamma 1 — Intent and UX:** intelligent starter actions, intent router, follow-up questions, multilingual behavior, mobile scroll/input, clear answer feedback (like/dislike), observability. Reuse existing code.
- **Gamma 2 — Multimodal and documents:** photo analysis, PDF reading/summarization/Q&A, secure temporary uploads, consent for storage, per-user isolation, retention/deletion, size and rate limits, GDPR/privacy and cost budgets. No automatic ingestion of user uploads into shared/public archive.
- **Gamma 3 — Safe calculations:** run approved archived Excel calculation models and user-supplied spreadsheets in sandboxed, isolated execution; validated inputs, formulas, outputs, provenance, resource/time limits; never execute untrusted macros or arbitrary code. Use mature spreadsheet engines/libraries first.
- **Later:** validated Answer Catalog / canonical FAQs with versioned standard revalidation, quotas/metering and optional billing, My Elevator product finder. Supplier/spare-part sourcing remains a future Elevator Agent AI integration via an explicit tool contract.

## Acceptance / design gates
- Real-document end-to-end Living Archive test before Gamma.
- Human Beta test set: technical fault cases, verified standard clauses, ordinary conversational follow-ups, DE/FA/EN, mobile login and Google OAuth, performance/security/cost.
- For each new feature: inventory existing OpenAI/ChatGPT, GitHub, Gemini, Cloudflare and OSS tools; choose use/extend/build with rationale, measured costs and security review; add offline regression tests and production smoke checks.
- No new paid services or production deployment without explicit approval.

## Next action
After Beta is closed, decompose this roadmap into small independent implementation issues, beginning with Gamma 1. Do not start coding from this issue alone.
